notes.title: Хотите познать, что такое МЕМОЛОГИЯ в разрезе стратегии?
notes.content:
Do you want to know what exactly MEMOLOGY is? This question is difficult to answer, this series of games needs to be checked out on your own, to feel each of the scientific topics.

Why should you play this particular part?

[list]
[*] Do you need a battle for internet dominance? Isn't this the mythological story of real battles and battles?
[*] 
[*] And maybe the developer will be happy, because you can play it for hours? (real playtime)
[*] 
[*] Do you like something similar to TABS? But do you want something new from special modes (story company or co-op) to well-remembered characters?
[*] 
[/list]

Well, what exactly is useful for this post for OLDIES - [b]achievements have been added to the game, biggest update with small fixes!!![/b]
